content: Marvel Rivals, the Overwatch -like hero shooter from NetEase and Marvel Games, is just a couple of weeks away from its second anniversary. To celebrate, The Lego Group is releasing a new set based on the game's take on an iconic Marvel character. This will be the first-ever Marvel Rivals set, though plenty of Marvel sets already exist, and to mark the occasion, it will turn the beloved Jeff the Land Shark into a brick-built figure.
